input.goal: Dredge each Chicken-cheese ball into flour, then dip into egg and roll in the breadcrumbs, ensuring the entire surface of the chicken ball is covered in breadcrumbs.

sub_goals.text: Set up the breadcrumbs in a bowl
Store the breadcrumbs container and prepare the flour bowl
Retrieve flour from the cabinet and pour it into the bowl
Form the first chicken ball and coat it with flour
Dip the first chicken ball in egg and coat it with breadcrumbs
Form the second chicken ball and coat it with flour
Dip the second chicken ball in egg, sprinkle with more flour, and coat it with breadcrumbs

skills.action_temporal_order: L2: the order of two actions shown close together inside one sub-goal
skills.sound_action_binding: L2: which action / object produced the sound heard
skills.object_state_change: L2: where an object was taken from and where it went in one movement

l3_relation_types.object_continuity: the same object / ingredient appears in an event of sub-goal k and an event of the ADJACENT sub-goal k+1; what happened to it between them (chopped broccoli -> in the pan)
l3_relation_types.state_change: how the state of an object differs between the two events (whole -> chopped, empty -> full, raw -> browned)
l3_relation_types.causal_prerequisite: the earlier event is a physical prerequisite of the later one (could not be done without it)
l3_relation_types.hidden_state: an appliance / container state was set in the earlier event and is not visible in the later segment; what is its state at the end of the later segment
l3_relation_types.spatial_end_state: after placements in the two events, which listed object ends nearest / farthest to a reference object (needs 3D records)

plan.goal: Dredge each Chicken-cheese ball into flour, then dip into egg and roll in the breadcrumbs, ensuring the entire surface of the chicken ball is covered in breadcrumbs.

events.description: Pour breadcrumbs from the container into a bowl.
events.relevance: prepares the breadcrumb station for dredging

events.description: The rustling sound of breadcrumbs hitting the bowl.
Place the breadcrumbs container away in a storage area.
Place an empty bowl on the counter for the flour.
Take the flour from the cabinet.
events.relevance: gets the flour needed for dredging

events.description: Pour the flour into the empty bowl.
Shape the chicken and cheese mixture into a ball using hands.
Roll the chicken ball in the flour bowl to coat it.
Dip the floured chicken ball into the egg bowl.
Roll the egg-coated chicken ball in the breadcrumbs bowl.
Shape the second chicken and cheese mixture into a ball.
Roll the second chicken ball in the flour bowl.
events.relevance: applies the first dredging layer to the second ball

events.description: Dip the second floured chicken ball into the egg bowl.
events.relevance: applies the binding layer to the second ball

events.description: Sprinkle extra flour onto the chicken ball.
events.relevance: adds more dry coating before breading

events.description: Roll the second chicken ball in the breadcrumbs bowl.
events.relevance: applies the final breadcrumb coating to the second ball

relations.ask: What was dispensed from the container before it was stored away?
relations.answer_hint: The container held breadcrumbs that were poured in the previous step.

relations.ask: Why was the empty bowl placed on the counter?
relations.answer_hint: It was placed to receive the flour poured in the next step.

relations.ask: What ingredient was added to the bowl before the chicken ball was rolled in it?
relations.answer_hint: Flour was poured into the bowl.

relations.ask: What was the coating on the chicken ball just before it was dipped in the egg?
relations.answer_hint: It was coated in flour in the previous step.

relations.ask: What was the person doing with the chicken mixture after finishing the first breaded ball?
relations.answer_hint: They started shaping a second ball from the same mixture.

relations.ask: What was the coating on the second chicken ball just before it was dipped in the egg?
relations.answer_hint: It was coated in flour in the previous step.

decision_points.why: After setting up the breadcrumbs, the person must decide to store the container and prepare the next bowl rather than immediately starting to bread.
After placing the empty bowl, the person must decide to fetch the flour from the cabinet.
With the stations set up, the person decides to start forming the first chicken ball.
Dipping in egg and breadcrumbs is the standard, immediate continuation of the dredging process after flouring.
After finishing the first ball, the person must decide to repeat the process for a second ball.
Dipping the second ball in egg and breadcrumbs is the standard continuation of the dredging process.
After the second ball is fully coated, the person must decide what to do next, such as frying them, washing hands, or making a third ball.
